articles.title: Photo of reported crocodile sighting at Pandan Reservoir found to be fake; police report lodged: PUB
articles.content: A police report has been made, PUB said, adding that search operations for the reptile have ceased. PUB takes a serious view of false information that may cause public alarm and disrupt activities, it added. The police confirmed that a report had been lodged and said that investigations are ongoing

articles.title: Woman falls after allegedly riding escalator with shopping trolley at Yishun mall
articles.content: A shopping trolley can also be seen near the escalator. The incident took place on the escalator connecting the first and second floors of Junction Nine, Lianhe Zaobao reported. The woman is believed to have fallen while riding the escalator with the shopping trolley. @asiaone The incident took place at Junction Nine in Yishun on Wednesday (Aug 19) at around 4.45pm.
